description: Search sales invoices from the signed-in owner’s latest completed SHVL Xero sync by invoice number or customer name. Read-only, capped at 20 and not live Xero state. Results are paged. applied_filters echoes validated predicates and calculation date. Use next_cursor with the same filters until has_more is false; total_count counts all filtered matches. Data changes invalidate continuation. Amount filters require currency; case/contact dates use oldest positive overdue date in the selected currency when supplied and amounts use the selected currency overdue subtotal. Returned summaries retain all currencies. Detail filters apply to invoice history, not case metadata.

as_of_date.description: UTC date for days-overdue filters. Defaults to today and is fixed across continuation pages.

case_status.description: Exact case-workflow status, including for invoice searches.

currency.description: ISO currency. Required with amount bounds; no currency conversion.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the preceding page. Repeat the same filters; changed data requires restarting.

due_from.description: Inclusive due date; cases use oldest overdue invoice date.

exclude_case_statuses.description: Exclude these case-workflow statuses, including when searching invoices.

exclude_statuses.description: Statuses to exclude. Invoice searches use invoice status; cases and contacts use case status.

limit.description: Number of matching records to return; omit to use the server default.

max_amount_minor.description: Inclusive outstanding amount maximum in the selected currency.

min_amount_minor.description: Inclusive outstanding amount minimum in the selected currency; cases use overdue balance.

promise_from.description: Inclusive recorded payment-promise date; excludes cases without a promise.

query.description: Optional text matched against invoice number or customer name in the selected business; omit to list synced records.

readiness_status.description: Exact payment-readiness state of the associated case.

status.description: Optional synced invoice status; overdue selects outstanding invoices past their due date.

workspace_id.description: Selected business ID from list_shvl_workspaces. Ask the user to choose if several businesses are available; never infer another business.

name: search_xero_invoices

outputSchema.description: filters echoes applied query and status; invoice_count counts returned invoices. invoices contains SHVL invoice_id and customer_id values, invoice numbers, dates, currency, total_minor, amount_due_minor and synced status. Monetary values are currency minor units. source records the completed Xero sync; results are not a live Xero lookup.
